user.title: Torque Pro
user.description:
In the Torque Pro app go to Settings → Data Logging & Upload → Webserver URL and enter:

`{url}`

Also usable (old address, while the core torque integration is not configured): `{legacy_url}`

Enable "Send https: Bearer Token" and enter a Home Assistant long-lived access token. Vehicles and their sensors appear automatically with the first upload.

data_description.email: Only accept uploads whose "User Email Address" in the app matches. Leave empty to accept all.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Torque Pro is already set up. All phones and vehicles use the same entry.

data_description.driving_timeout: The "Active" sensor turns off after this long without an upload.
